title: Add VINE non-record submission: zero-parameter geometric byte predictor
author: RaychellLangan

data.description: Zero-learned-parameter geometric byte-level predictor using fixed structural priors and PPM byte counts; no transformer, no gradient descent, no backpropagation, and no loss function.

novel_contributions: Non-record submission with no training loop
PPM byte-counts plus fixed structural priors
Evaluation on a 500,000-byte FineWeb validation slice
